title: Cosmic Portal Over Meadow
description: A surreal landscape shows rolling green hills dotted with red poppies in the foreground. In the sky, a large swirling formation of white clouds creates a circular portal revealing a dark space void with a glowing turquoise and gold rim, stars, and small celestial bodies.
prompt: Surreal landscape with lush rolling green hills and vibrant red poppies in the foreground under a dramatic sky. A massive swirling vortex of white fluffy clouds forms a circular portal revealing a deep black cosmic void with glowing turquoise and golden atmospheric rings, scattered stars, and small celestial orbs floating within the opening.
